name: Dilolo

queries.query: Dilolo Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral map parcel registry official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ministry of Land Affairs page listing Dilolo as one of five Lualaba land-registration districts. The ministry's public land-research workflow explains how to submit a formal search, but no anonymous public parcel map/API or ID-plus-geometry response was found.

queries.query: Dilolo RDC cadastre parcelles carte registre foncier officiel
queries.result: La recherche de première partie confirme que Dilolo est une circonscription foncière de la province du Lualaba. Le formulaire officiel de recherche foncière demande une province, une circonscription et des références de bien, mais ne publie pas de service anonyme de parcelles avec identifiant et géométrie; aucune demande nécessitant identité ou pièces n'a été soumise.

registryCustodian.name: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo
registryCustodian.scope: National land-affairs authority; its official administrative list explicitly places Dilolo in the Lualaba land-registration districts.

localCustodianContext.name: Dilolo land-registration district (circonscription foncière), Lualaba
localCustodianContext.scope: Officially listed local/territorial registration custodian context. No separate public Dilolo map, endpoint, contact workflow, or parcel dataset was exposed by the page.

service.name: Ministry of Land Affairs public land-research workflow
service.viewerConfiguration: The current Next.js HTML and referenced JavaScript were inspected. The public workflow contains province/circonscription selectors and a POST form for a formal land search; it requires applicant identity/contact data and supporting documents. No map viewer, public parcel layer, ArcGIS/GeoServer/WFS/WMS endpoint, or anonymous parcel response was exposed.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Loaded the official administrative list. It reports 143 circonscriptions across 26 provinces and lists Dilolo under Lualaba. The HTML contained no parcel geometry, native parcel IDs, CRS, or public map-service configuration.

Loaded the official formal-search workflow. The current JavaScript was inspected; its only data submission route is /api/demandes-foncieres and the form requires identity/contact and document fields. No POST was made because it would submit personal data and request a protected land-record search.

Public Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales landing page loaded. It states the digital cadastral service is available for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; no Dilolo/Lualaba parcel service or anonymous parcel response was exposed.

A catalogue record for a 1959 administrative map of the Dilolo territory was discovered, but the direct API request failed certificate verification. It is an administrative reference map, not a current parcel dataset; no TLS bypass was attempted.
